conclusions: Main MLP net R5_PC minus R5 has a negative point estimate with an interval spanning zero; incremental benefit is not established, and neither harm nor equivalence is established.
Context and peptide-only increments, ridge versions and >=50 sensitivity are likewise inconclusive. No additional arm should be selected by the secondary results.

On identical old4449 queries, expanded fitting raises all absolute scores but neural net increment shrinks from+0.018816 to+0.001088 (min20) and context turns negative. This cannot be explained solely by changing the query population, but source coverage, inner selection and stopping changes remain inseparable; fixed-query points have no added intervals.
The earlier balanced-panel small positive point is not supported as a persistent full-cohort net advantage in this fixed recipe. This does not reject all inverse-folding encoders or architectures.

Stop computational search as planned. Retain useful main learned-representation and few-shot findings, all inconclusive descriptor findings and every original-family result. Do not promote this selected overlapping extension as a fourth primary or independent confirmation.

No added ProteinMPNN descriptor is justified as an established improvement to R5 by these data. Prospective independent assay validation remains the next scientific requirement; no new purchases/outreach/studies are authorized by this review.
